dedupe_keys.name: cbam sector global facility registry cement iron and steel and aluminium producers with emissions provenance

description: This open registry lists 3,421 industrial facilities in three CBAM Annex I good categories, cement (2,160), iron and steel (953) and aluminium (308), across 145 countries, 3,102 of them outside the EU-27. The Zenodo record says each facility has name, country, coordinates, owner, capacity where known and a modelled annual CO2 estimate from Climate TRACE, and 360 facilities also carry a regulator-reported CO2 figure from the EU ETS registry or US EPA GHGRP with match evidence. It was published by Dmytro Aheiev of the company Inzonex (version 1.1.0, August 2026) under the CC BY 4.0 licence, free to download as CSV and JSON with a data dictionary, build script and Croissant metadata. Coverage is global. Caveats: the record states facility totals are not embedded emissions or CBAM liability, there are no production volumes, coverage follows Climate TRACE detection, not a census, and fertilisers, hydrogen and electricity are excluded. For simulation it gives geolocated heavy-industry plants with owners and emissions to model trade exposure, carbon border costs and supply disruption. Related catalogue records include Climate TRACE and the Global Cement and Concrete Tracker.
